editorial.blurb: Ttowa Korean Bistro is a beloved family-owned neighborhood gem serving authentic, generously portioned Korean food with genuinely warm service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the tteokbokki and ask your server for recommendations — they're spot-on and attentive, and you can get unlimited rice, tea, and side dishes.

topDishes.note: crispy outside, chewy inside — so good people order seconds
